events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the world lost Queen frontman Freddie Mercury on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we said goodbye to one of music's most iconic voices, Freddie Mercury. His legacy lives on.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: An absolute game-changer. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped on this day in '65, forever shifting the landscape of pop music. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of The Beatles legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost a true icon. Remembering John Lennon today, whose music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman. David Bowie would have been 80 today, still influencing generations with his incredible artistry.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92

angles.name: Tribute Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. What's your go-to track from the legend?

events.title: The Day The Music Died
